title: Korean AI collaborative writing analysis: Code and pseudonymized analytical data
description: Researcher-written Python analysis code and pseudonymized paper-scope analytical data: six F1–F3 automated measures, F4 grammatical-error measurements, F5–F8 form-source metrics, and F9/F10 coding labels. The package contains 252 text rows, 84 task rows and 802 coded meaning units. Learner text and direct/original identifiers are excluded. Raw statistics and within-measure pairwise tests can be replayed; previously reported omnibus adjusted p-values are reference-only and are excluded from independent recalculation claims. 논문 분석 범위의 Python 코드와 가명 분석 자료를 제공하며, 학습자 원문과 식별 정보는 공개하지 않는다.
notes: Executable code: MIT. Pseudonymized data, aggregate tables and research documentation: CC BY 4.0. Original learner texts and identifiers are excluded.
